name: TBL-EXT-06: Create fails after binding a direct counter [BUG? B4]
setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
$TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt table_acts act name ptables/nosuch 2>/tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.err
verifyCmd: { cat /tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.err; $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt && echo DELETED; } 2>&1; true
